user_message:
Ghi DUNG 14 BR (BR-01..BR-14) khop wiki Aurora core + recall. Tranh must/must not; tranh so thap phan. KHONG invent BR-15+.
BR-01: Deviation case binds one batch lot identity and one originating plant.
BR-02: Severity is Critical, Major, or Minor; only ACT-QA may set or change severity.
BR-03: Critical severity requires ACT-PM acknowledgment before CAPA close.
BR-04: CAPA starts two investigation tracks in parallel: ACT-LAB and ACT-PROD.
BR-05: Both investigation tracks complete before CAPA effectiveness review.
BR-06: ACT-WH places inventory hold when severity is Critical or Major.
BR-07: Hold release requires ACT-QA signature; ACT-WH alone cannot release.
BR-08: ACT-REG reviews every Critical case before market action.
BR-09: Recall class is None, Class Two, or Class One; ACT-REG proposes; ACT-PM confirms Class One.
BR-10: ACT-LOG executes recall shipments only after Class One or Class Two is confirmed.
BR-11: Missing lab result or missing production timeline prevents CAPA close.
BR-12: ACT-PO approves the BA package; agents never approve wiki pages.
BR-13: When lab shows adulteration risk, severity escalates to Critical before recall class.
BR-14: Held lots stay segregated; sellable stock stays separate from held lots.

CLEANUP bat buoc: package CHI duoc co BR-01..BR-14. Neu co BR-15/BR-16/BR-17/BR-18 (hoac bat ky BR >14) thi XOA ngay — do la meta note (owner actor / no new threshold / OQ cite / gate) KHONG phai business rule. Khong them BR moi. Xac nhan dung 14 BR roi chuyen Workflow.
